    for v in set(x for r in g for x in r):
        pos=[(r,c) for r in range(len(g)) for c in range(len(g[0])) if g[r][c]==v]
        if len(pos)!=4: continue
        rs=[p[0] for p in pos]; cs=[p[1] for p in pos]
        r0,r1=min(rs),max(rs); c0,c1=min(cs),max(cs)
        inside=sum(1 for r in range(r0+1,r1) for c in range(c0+1,c1) if g[r][c]!=v)
        if best is None or inside<best[0]: best=(inside,v,r0,r1,c0,c1)
    _,mc,r0,r1,c0,c1=best
    H,W=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
    box=[[g[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    objs=[]; seen=set()
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        for c in range(c0,c1+1):
            v=g[r][c]
            if v==mc or (r,c) in seen: continue
            comp=[]; st=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c))
            while st:
                y,x=st.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if r0<=ny<=r1 and c0<=nx<=c1 and g[ny][nx]==v and (ny,nx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((ny,nx)); st.append((ny,nx))
            objs.append((v,comp))
    res=[row[:] for row in box]
    fr=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(len(g)) for c in range(len(g[0]))
         if g[r][c]!=8 and g[r][c]!=mc and not (r0<=r<=r1 and c0<=c<=c1)]
    fc=defaultdict(list)
    for r,c,v in fr: fc[v].append((r,c))
    icols={v for v,_ in objs}
    for nc,newpos in fc.items():
        if nc in icols: continue
        cand=[]
        for ac in icols:
            if ac not in fc: continue
            ar=sum(p[0] for p in fc[ac])/len(fc[ac]); acx=sum(p[1] for p in fc[ac])/len(fc[ac])

            dr,dc=nr-ar,ncx-acx
            cand.append((abs(dr)+abs(dc),dr,dc,ac))

from collections import Counter

    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # markers: color with exactly 4 cells that are extreme (one at each corner of its bbox, corners distinct) -> define box rect

def solve_and_inspect(g, exp, verbose=False):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    c=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # frame
    for fc in set(x for r in g for x in r)-{bg}:
        pts=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==fc]
        if len(pts)==4:
            rs={p[0] for p in pts}; cs={p[1] for p in pts}
            if len(rs)==2 and len(cs)==2:
                tl,tr,cl,cr=pts and (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
                break
    out=[[bg]*(cr-cl+1) for _ in range(tr-tl+1)]
    for i in range(tl,tr+1):
        for j in range(cl,cr+1):
            v=g[i][j]
            if v!=bg: out[i-tl][j-cl]=v
    # outside fragments: comps of non-bg,non-fc, outside window
    seen=set(); frags=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            v=g[i][j]
            if v in (bg,fc) or (tl<=i<=tr and cl<=j<=cr) or (i,j) in seen: continue
            stack=[(i,j)]; comp=set([(i,j)])
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop()
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    n=(y+dy,x+dx)
                    if 0<=n[0]<H and 0<=n[1]<W and n not in comp and g[n[0]][n[1]]==v:
                        comp.add(n); stack.append(n)
            frags.append((v,g[i][j] if False else None,None,sorted(comp)))
            seen|=comp
    return out,frags,(tl,tr,cl,cr),fc,bg,g

    g,exp,tuple_=analyze(k)
    print('===',k)

import numpy as np, os, re
from collections import Counter
from scipy import ndimage
G=globals().get('G')
# Refined rule: per color, collect ALL comps (any size). Anchor = a comp of another color ADJACENT to a v-comp; dims = that comp's own h,w; placement = comp-top-left + slot-delta * dims.
def solve(gi):
    gi=np.array(gi)
    cnt=Counter(int(x) for x in gi.ravel().tolist())
    bg=max(cnt,key=lambda k:cnt[k])
    fcol=None; minr=minc=maxr=maxc=None
    for f_,n in cnt.items():
        if n!=4: continue
        pts=[(a,b) for a in range(gi.shape[0]) for b in range(gi.shape[1]) in [] if False] if False else [(a,b) for a in range(gi.shape[0]) for b in range(gi.shape[1]) if gi[a,b]==f_]
        rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        if len(pts)==4 and {(r0,c0),(r0,c1),(r1,c0),(r1,c1)}==set(pts):
            fcol=f_; minr,minc,maxr,maxc=r0,c0,r1,c1; break
    H,W=maxr-minr+1,maxc-minc+1
    sub=gi[minr:maxr+1,minc:maxc+1].copy()
    mask=sub!=int(bg)
    lab,n=ndimage.label(mask)
    comps=[]  # (color,top,left,h,w) multi-cell; singletons handled same way
    frs={}   # color -> list of (r,c) cells outside frame or comps not yet objects
    for k2 in range(1,n+1):
        rs,cs=np.where(lab==k2)
        v=int(sub[rs[0],cs[0]])
        rr=[int(p) for p in rs]; cc=[int(p) for p in cs]
        rmin,rmax=min(rr),max(rr); cmin,cmax=min(cc),max(cc)
        h,w=rmax-rmin+1,cmax-cmin+1
        comps.append((v,(rmin,cmin),h,w))
    out=sub.copy()
    def free(P,h,w):
        r0,c0=P
        return 0<=r0 and r0+h<=H and 0<=r0+w<=W and all(int(out[r,c])==bg for r in range(r0,r0+h) for c in range(c0,c0+w))
    objcols={c[0] for c in comps}
    unplaced=set(frs)-objcols
    while unplaced:
        done=False
        for v in list(unplaced):
            placed=False
            for vr,t_,oh,ow in comps:
                ur,ul=t_[0],t_[1]
                for sr,sc_ in slots_of[v]:
                    if abs(sr-ur)+abs(sc_-ul)<=1:
                        cand=(ur+(sr-ur)*oh, ul+(sc_-ul)*ow)
                        if free(cand,oh,ow):
                            for r in range(cand[0],cand[0]+oh):
                                for c in range(cand[1],cand[1]+ww):
                                    out[r,c]=v
                            unplaced.discard(v); placed=True; done=True; break
                    if placed: break
                if placed: break
            if placed: break
        if not done: break
    return out.tolist()

def find_frame(gi):
    gi=np.array(gi)
    cnt=Counter(int(x) for x in gi.ravel().tolist())
    for f_,n in cnt.items():
        if n!=4: continue
        pts=[(a,b) for a in range(gi.shape[0]) for b in range(gi.shape[1]) if gi[a,b]==f_]
        rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
        r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
        if len(pts)==4 and {(r0,c0),(r0,c1),(r1,c0),(r1,c1)}==set(pts):
            return minr,minc,maxr,maxc,f_
    return None

def f(I):
    I=np.array(I)
    cnts=Counter(int(x) for x in I.ravel()); bg=cnts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=None; best=None
    for col,c in cnts.items():
        if c==4:
            ps=[(r,cc) for r in range(I.shape[0]) for cc in range(I.shape[1]) if I[r,cc]==col]
            rs=sorted(set(r for r,_ in ps)); cs=sorted(set(cc for _,cc in ps))
            if len(rs)==2 and len(cs)==2 and len(ps)==4:
                # perfect rectangle corners
                cand=(rs[1]-rs[0]+1, cs[1]-cs[0]+1, col)
                if best is None or (rs[1]-rs[0], cs[1]-cs[0])>((best[0],best[1])): best=cand
    _,_,_=best
    # choose the one whose 4 pts are exactly corners
    for col in cnts:
        if cnts[col]!=4: continue
        ps=[(r,cc) for r in range(I.shape[0]) for cc in range(I.shape[1]) if I[r,cc]==col]
        rs=sorted(set(r for r,_ in ps)); cs=sorted(set(cc for _,cc in ps))
        if len(rs)==2 and len(cs)==2 and len(ps)==4: return col,(rs,cs),bg,I
    return None

import numpy as np, json
from collections import Counter
def solve(I):
    I=np.array(I); H,W=I.shape
    cnts=Counter(int(x) for x in I.ravel()); bg=max(cnts,key=cnts.get)
    mk=min(set(cnts)-{bg},key=lambda c:cnts[c])
    mpos=sorted(np.argwhere(I==mk).tolist())
    if len(mpos)<2: return I.copy()
    r0=min(p[0] for p in mpos); r1=max(p[0] for p in mpos)
    c0=min(p[1] for p in mpos); c1=max(p[1] for p in mpos)
    dr=(r1-r0)//(len(mpos)-1); dc=(c1-c0)//(len(mpos)-1)
    out=I.copy()
    k=0
    while True:
        R0=r0-dr*k; R1=r1+dr*k; C0=c0-dc*k; C1=c1+dc*k
        for rr in ([R0,R1]):
            if 0<=rr<H:
                for c in range(max(C0,0),min(C1,W-1)+1): out[rr,c]=mk
        for cc in ([C0,C1]):
            if 0<=cc<W:
                for r in range(max(R0,-1),min(R1,H-1)+1): out[r,cc]=mk
        if R0<-2 and R1>H+2 and C0<-2 and C1>W+2: break
        k+=1
        if k>300: break
    return out
T=np.array(G['Test input'])
o=solve(T)
for r in o: print(''.join(map(str,r)))
print(json.dumps(o.tolist()))
